message.content:
(1) **Footer Presence & Content:** Yes, the footer is present and occupies the very bottom of the page. It is a multi-column layout containing:
*   **Brand Column:** MEDINA EKONOMI logo, tagline ("Masyarakat Ekonomi Digital Nasional"), description text, and social media icons (GitHub, Twitter, LinkedIn, Telegram).
*   **Pilar Ekonomi:** Links for Digitalisasi Pajak, OPD, Perijinan, RKUD Live, WargaID.
*   **Platform:** Links for Medina-AI, Chain ledger, Open API, InsightBI, Ops Center, Medina Go.
*   **Tata Kelola:** Links for Keamanan Siber, Audit Trail, Privasi Data, Interoperabilitas, SLA Publik.
*   **Kemitraan:** Links for Pemerintah Pusat/Daerah, Bumn & Bumd, Asosiasi, Akademisi, Holding MEDINA.
*   **Bottom Bar:** A promotional banner for "Holding ekosistem MEDINA", followed by the copyright line (© 2026) and utility links (Privasi, Syarat, Keamanan) plus version number.

(2) **Colors:**
*   **Background:** Deep dark green/black (`#0a1f1c` or similar), which perfectly aligns with the "emerald" preference.
*   **Accents:** Vibrant emerald/cyan gradients used in the main CTA button ("Ajukan Integrasi Daerah") and the logo. Amber/yellow used for the word "Digital" in the hero heading.
*   **Text:** White for headings, light gray/muted green for body text. No forbidden blue or indigo tones are present.

(3) **Layout & Rendering:**
*   The layout is clean, well-structured, and uses a standard 5-column grid that aligns perfectly with the content above it.
*   There are **no** blank areas below the footer; it extends fully to the bottom edge of the viewport/image.
*   No text overflow or broken rendering is visible. All icons and text are crisp.

(4) **Trailing Whitespace/Cut-off:**
*   There is **no trailing whitespace**. The footer content ends precisely at the bottom boundary with the copyright line.
*   Nothing appears to be cut off. The final pixel row contains the copyright text and version info (`v3.2.1`).

(5) **Visual Quality:**
*   High-quality, modern "dark mode" aesthetic.
*   Excellent contrast and hierarchy. The use of emerald glows on interactive elements (buttons/icons) provides a premium, tech-forward feel consistent with a national digital economy platform.
